state.question: For Canal Utility, what do the latest records show about treatment energy? Please resolve this specific point: September treatment energy per delivered cubic metre compared with August at the same boundary.
state.conclusion: Canal commissioned a new membrane treatment stage.
state.gap: September treatment energy per delivered cubic metre compared with August at the same boundary.
